s.note: for the top hat and the dark
s.how: Pop 120g kernels in a lidded pot with 2 tbsp oil. Toss straight away in 50g melted butter, 2 tsp cracked black pepper, 40g finely grated parmesan and fine salt so it all sticks while the corn is hot.

s.note: Samuel's party with his cousin Ruby
s.how: Spread 8 slices fresh white bread with soft butter right to the edges. Press face down into a plate of hundreds and thousands. Trim the crusts and cut into triangles. Make it close to serving so it stays soft.

m.how: Brown 4 lamb shanks. Soften 1 onion and 2 carrots, add 250ml red wine, a tin of tomatoes and rosemary. Return the shanks, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve over 1kg potatoes mashed with butter.

w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, then fold in 120g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes and split. Brush with syrup and 3 tbsp kirsch. Layer with 400ml whipped cream and a drained jar of morello cherries. Shave dark chocolate on top.

d.note: Amelia, desperate for one night's sleep
d.how: Warm 1L milk gently in a saucepan until steaming, without boiling. Stir in 3 tbsp honey and a pinch of cinnamon, whisk until frothy and pour into 4 mugs.
